saw_lines: Bedding gets chosen by fabric first. Buyers weigh linen against cotton, then pick a pattern for the room, then check delivery.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, before a buyer has chosen a fabric.
Your site lists 9,000 five star reviews, yet only 3 of 30 live ads carry that number. Print your 30 day returns on the creative in line one.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site lists 9,000 five star reviews, yet only 3 of 30 live ads carry that number. Scrolling buyers miss that trust. Print your 30 day returns on the creative in line one, and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 15% off mix and match, yet only 4 of 25 ads mention any offer. A new buyer has no reason to act. Open three new ads with spend £120 for £20 off, an offer no ad uses.
Your shipping page explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 30 ads answer that. Buyers wondering about the box hold off. Film one video ad showing the box arriving at the door and lead with it.
The “This season” opener runs unchanged in 8 of your 25 ads, so buyers see identical copy. Keep the body copy, but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each of those 8 ads.

ads_1: Spend £120 offer and returns lead line one, tested against the heritage opener.
